Of Surveying and Measuring of Land.

HITHERTO we have treated of the measuring of angles and sides, whence it is abundantly easy to lay down a field, a plane, or an entire country: for to this nothing is requisite but the projection of triangles, and of other plain figures, after having measured their sides and angles.
